findings.message: Malformed client updates bypass the new rejection guard whenever the server document has not been created. doc starts as null, and the WebSocket upgrade only loads update buffers; applyClientUpdate skips Y.applyUpdate when doc is null and returns true. A malformed MSG_YJS_UPDATE received in that state therefore reaches pushUpdate, trackUpdate, broadcast and scheduleSave in BoardRoom.webSocketMessage, including delivery to clients whose ws-provider calls Y.applyUpdate on the payload.

An update arriving during an outstanding save can remain unpersisted indefinitely. scheduleSave now keeps saveScheduled true until storage.put resolves. After line 62 snapshots the buffer, a new client update is appended but its scheduleSave call returns at line 57; finally only clears the flag and schedules no subsequent write. If no further updates arrive, that update is absent from storage. schedulePartitionSave in partition-manager.ts has the same sequence.
